:new: New project intention · #17 Basic properties of hyperbolic space

Formalise the basics of hyperbolic space, using the differential geometry approach ("a Riemannian manifold with constant curvature -1"). This builds on ongoing work by Macbeth, Massot and Rothgang (public in mathlib PR #36036). This specific project will include

  • define the standard hyperbolic metric metric on the Poincaré disk and upper half-space (as a ContMDiffRiemannianMetric)
  • define Riemannian isometries, show these preserve Levi-Civita connection, curvature, geodesics etc.
  • relate the metric on the Poincaré disk and upper half-space with an isometry
  • compute the Levi-Civita connection w.r.t. these metrics; deduce they have constant curvature -1
  • determine its geodesics and the isometry group
  • potential further directions are towards the Gauss-Bonnet theorem

All of this work aims for mathlib-quality and eventual inclusion into mathlib.
